title: Faith
old_caption: Your heart showed up in chains and three padlocks. The stars swear they're professionals, and to prove it, they did the trust fall first. Pisces cried, obviously. What's your heart wearing today?

title: What if the stars chose?
old_caption: The stars took the phone away mid-scroll, read the birthday (and the birth time, because the rising sign is picky), and found Venus in Aries. That explains a lot. What's your Venus?

title: Never more connected
old_caption: 2:14 AM: 214 matches, zero conversations. The stars call that a collection, not dating. Then one talk card lands, and suddenly it's 3:41. What question would you want someone to ask you?

title: Starters, keepers, changers
old_caption: Aries smashes START three times. Taurus padlocks it shut and calls it commitment. Gemini teleports left, right and center. Every team needs all three. Are you a starter, a keeper or a changer?

title: New Moon vs Full Moon
old_caption: New Moon: the gold star plants a seed and asks 'now??' Two weeks of naps later, Full Moon: it bloomed. Pisces is not crying, you are. When did you last look up at the moon?

title: Meet your opposite sign
old_caption: Six opposite pairs on one seesaw, a referee star in the middle, and then Pisces lands so hard the referee gets launched out of frame. Flip a Taurus, get a Scorpio. Who's your opposite sign?

title: Where did the zodiac come from?
old_caption: Story time: the zodiac from Babylon to the Greeks to Earth's wobble. Aries took every part personally, especially being called a little animal. Which sign would take it worst?

title: The stars give you a chance
old_caption: Seven chakra stars tried to peek behind the mystery card. One got bonked, one bent its periscope, and one gave up and held a NOT LOOKING sign. Could you resist peeking?

title: Dating, dealt by the stars
old_caption: For centuries you drew lines between the stars. Now the stars are drawing lines back, and Aquarius ducked out of the first one. Which sign would dodge the connection?

title: Put your wish in the stars
old_caption: A shooting star screeched to a stop, gave you one wish, and was on a schedule. 'Make them gorgeous' got stamped FACE LAST. Second try: someone who gets me. What's your wish?
